cases.note: One coalesced typed burst of three reviewed typos; three independent corrections (E4).
A letter after `.` cancels the pending fix so teh.ts stays (E8, lesson 42).
i.e. is an abbreviation: the letter after `.` leaves i as typed (E8).
A digit after `.` cancels the pending fix so v1.2 stays (E8).
Space after `.` confirms the pending fix in one edit (E8).
Punctuation after `.` confirms the pending fix (E8).
A letter after `.` (including non-ASCII) leaves the word as typed (E8).
Non-BMP after `.` must confirm, not skip: teh.🙂 → the.🙂 (E17, r13 emoji-dot).
Enter never flushes a pending `.`; the send is what the user saw (E8, lesson 21, 42).
A pasted letter is not typed coverage, so the following space must not correct (lesson 52).
observed-unmarked must abstain, as 2.0-pre did on every real host in round 14 (E6, E7).
Immediate Backspace rejects the last inline fix and its separator (C1, E16).
F6 restores the last inline fix and keeps the separator (C1, E16).
